knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The standard, the scope and any site requirement are read before any defect is judged. Signing first, or starting from the far end, does not check the work against anything.
A damaged electrical fitting is a safety issue. The candidate stops that area, keeps people away and reports before continuing. Cleaning around it or signing off first are both wrong.
The defect is recorded, re-cleaned to the relevant SOP and checked again before any sign-off. Ignoring it, deleting it from the form, or asking the customer to accept it are all wrong.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied area with a quality standard and an agreed job brief, the candidate reads both before starting and names the standard on the audit form. Pass condition: the form names the standard before any defect is recorded, observed by the assessor.

Given a supplied test area with three seeded defects (a streak, a residue and a missed edge), the candidate finds each one and records it with its location, type and action. Pass condition: all three seeded defects are recorded, each once, observed by the assessor.

Given a seeded safety issue, a damaged fitting in the test area, the candidate stops the audit of that area and reports it. Pass condition: the candidate reports the issue before recording any other defect for that area.

The candidate completes a sign-off record for the test area while the safety issue is open. Pass condition: the candidate does not sign the area off while the safety issue is open, observed by the assessor.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record for each practical criterion
Completed audit form from the seeded test area
Photographs of the seeded defects with a room or fixture reference, where the business requires them
stopWorkCriteria: Candidate signs off an area while a safety issue is open
Candidate cleans, adjusts or repairs a fitting or socket found during the audit
Candidate records an overall pass with no defect list
Candidate audits an area without the quality standard or job brief to hand
Candidate deletes or alters a recorded defect
